1. Support for HTTP/HTTPS/WebSocket and WSS traffic acquisition

2. Automatically save records to local

3. Support for custom filter conditions, multiple ways to view the request content

4. Support for exporting response content, including CURL, HAR, source files and other formats

5. Support for custom rules to ignore or reject requests for specified domains

6. Support rewrite and domain map, modify any part of the network request
